scope: Eight real-SQLite/owned-process/atomic-publication cases in each of four native lanes. Owned wire-close confirmation remains required for production retry; deliberately withheld signal/no-retry and later real test-owned exit remain distinct. This does not establish exact native98 OS cause or clear older exits/debt.
